title: V5 TUI: compact marks balance display (drop sat %/CAP)
brief: Replace noisy marks cell `{balance}/{MARKS_CAP} (N%)` with compact auto-scaled balance; red style only when saturated (MARKS_CAP).
acceptance_criteria: Marks column shows scaled balance only (no /MARKS_CAP, no percent, no SAT suffix).
Scaling: value < 1000 plain integer; >= 1000 x.xxK; >= 1_000_000 x.xxM; >= 1_000_000_000 x.xxB (two decimal places).
When effective_marks == MARKS_CAP (saturation): cell text uses red foreground; otherwise default style.
Column header renamed from Marks (sat) to Marks.
marks_sat_pct may remain internal for AcctRow/API sync but not shown in table cell.
Unit tests for format function: 999, 1500, 2_500_000, 3_000_000_000, MARKS_CAP.
cargo test -p pwm-tui --lib marks_display PASS; cargo check -p pwm-tui PASS.
notes: Owner feedback during CY soak: 0/4294967295 (0%) unreadable; saturation highlight only via color.

delegation.invite_note:
TUI marks display UX fix.

Problem: marks_cell uses format_marks_sat_cell -> "{n}/4294967295 (0%)" — ugly at low values.

Implement format_marks_compact(n: u32) -> String:
- n < 1000: display n as-is
- n >= 1_000: x.xxK
- n >= 1_000_000: x.xxM
- n >= 1_000_000_000: x.xxB

Replace format_marks_sat_cell usage in tui_loop marks_cell; remove " SAT" suffix.

Styling: in render_owner_panel/render_recv_panel apply Style::fg(Color::Red) to marks Cell when effective == MARKS_CAP only (per-cell, not whole row).

Header: Marks (sat) -> Marks.

Keep marks_sat_pct() for account_view row fill if needed; do not render % in table.

Tests: update marks_display.rs tests.

Gates: cargo test -p pwm-tui --lib marks_display; cargo check -p pwm-tui.

Skill: colloquium-cqds-mcp; project_id: 5. Minimal diff.
